title: OmniPrep™ For High Quality Genomic DNA Extraction From Yeast
author: G-Biosciences
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.e6fbhbn
materials: Allow the sample to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Pellet yeast cells
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1.5 ml overnight yeast culture into a 1.5 ml microfuge tube, centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 30 seconds, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in lysis mix
steps.instruction: Add 150 µl PBS, 5 µl LongLife™ Zymolyase®, and 1 µl β‑mercaptoethanol to the pellet and gently vortex to resuspend.

steps.title: Digest cell wall
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes with periodic mixing.

steps.title: Heat lysis
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample at 55–60 °C for 15 minutes (do not exceed 60 °C).

steps.title: Proteinase K treatment (optional)
steps.instruction: For maximum DNA recovery, add 1 µl Proteinase K per 100 µl Lysis Buffer, invert the tube periodically each hour, and incubate at 60 °C for 1–2 hours.

substeps.instruction: Add Proteinase K solution (1 µl per 100 µl Lysis Buffer).

steps.title: Add chloroform and mix
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl chloroform and invert the tube several times to mix.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 14,000 × g and carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a clean microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add DNA Stripping Solution
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl DNA Stripping Solution to the sample and invert several times to mix.

steps.title: Incubate with stripping solution
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample for 5–10 minutes at 60 °C.

steps.title: Add Precipitation Solution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl Precipitation Solution and invert several times; if a white precipitate does not form, add 50 µl aliquots of Precipitation Solution until it does.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl Precipitation Solution and invert.
If no white precipitate appears, add 50 µl increments of Precipitation Solution until a precipitate forms.

steps.title: Centrifuge precipitate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 14,000 × g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean tube, add 500 µl isopropanol, invert the tube 10 times, optionally add 2 µl Mussel Glycogen as a carrier, centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 5 minutes to pellet DNA, and remove the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatant to a clean tube.

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 700 µl 70 % ethanol and invert several times, centrifuge for 1 minute at 14,000 × g, decant or pipette off the ethanol, then invert the tube on a clean absorbent surface for several minutes to drain excess ethanol (do not let the pellet dry). Note: the pellet may be hard to see and loosely attached.

substeps.instruction: Decant or pipette off ethanol wash.
Invert tube on a clean absorbent surface for several minutes to drain excess ethanol (do not let pellet dry).
Note: pellet may be hard to see and loosely attached.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in TE buffer
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl TE Buffer to the pellet and incubate at room temperature for at least 15 minutes to rehydrate (alternatively incubate 5–60 minutes at 55–60 °C to speed rehydration).

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature ≥15 minutes, or 55–60 °C for 5–60 minutes.

steps.title: RNase treatment (optional)
steps.instruction: Add 1 µl LongLife™ RNase per 100 µl TE Buffer (optional).

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store DNA at 4 °C for short‑term use; for long‑term storage keep at –20 °C or –80 °C. Typical yield is 3–6 µg per ml yeast culture.

steps.title: Re‑lyse pellet (optional)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 14,000 × g and pour off the supernatant, gently vortex to resuspend the pellet in residual liquid, add 500 µl Genomic Lysis Buffer, and invert several times (do not vortex).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 5 minutes at 14,000 × g and pour off supernatant.
Gently vortex to resuspend pellet in residual liquid.
